correctness.rationale: The exact parameter is cyclic 3-symbol distance d_3>=5 for unrestricted binary words of length six, no linearity assumption. Agreement on any four consecutive bit coordinates forces two equal consecutive length-three windows and d_3≤4, so projection injectivity gives |C|≤2^4=16. An independent adjacency computation on all 64 words found 1,632 d_3-compatible unordered pairs; independent Bron–Kerbosch exhaustive maximal-clique enumeration reported exactly 100,772 maximal cliques with size distribution 8:10712,9:33216,10:23936,11:19200,12:10688,13:2304,14:640,16:76. The 76 maximal size16 cliques are all possible labeled equality cases; no larger clique exists by the projection bound and enumeration. From these exact codebooks, 64 XOR translations plus D_6 (six rotations, six reflections) give 768 distance-preserving transformations with maximum-code orbit sizes 4,4,12,24,32, and exactly 44 affine translates of 4-flats; the 32 nonlinear maxima comprise the unique 32-element orbit. Full metric-isometry group is NOT claimed. The two algorithms were independently constructed from inspected definitions and cross-check the finite census; the finite result is exhaustive because all vertices and all maximal cliques are enumerated, not sampled.
